title: Data-Algorithm-Architecture Co-Optimization for Fair Neural Networks on Skin Lesion Dataset
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness for neural networks on skin lesion datasets, specifically addressing bias related to skin tone.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its scope is limited to fairness in medical image analysis concerning skin tone.
